items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
SELECT traffic_source,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0) AS last_week_sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0) AS this_week_sessions,
       COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0) AS change_sessions,
       ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0)
         - COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0))
         / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(sessions) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date), 0), 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY this_week_sessions DESC, traffic_source

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
WITH scoped_events AS (
  SELECT session_id, device_type, event_name, timestamp
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 7
    AND timestamp < current_date
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL
), session_flags AS (
  SELECT session_id,
         (array_agg(device_type ORDER BY timestamp))[1] AS device_type,
         bool_or(event_name = 'is_payment') AS paid
  FROM scoped_events
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown') AS device_type,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid) AS payment_sessions,
       ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE paid) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS payment_conversion_rate_pct
FROM session_flags
GROUP BY COALESCE(device_type, 'unknown')
ORDER BY device_type

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, count(*)::numeric AS unique_users
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
), periods AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 THEN '최근 7일' ELSE '그 전 7일' END AS period,
    unique_users
  FROM daily
)
SELECT period,
       count(*) AS days_with_data,
       avg(unique_users) AS avg_daily_unique_users,
       sum(unique_users) AS total_daily_unique_users
FROM periods
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '그 전 7일' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT event_name,
         SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
                                   AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date) AS last_week_count,
         SUM(event_count) FILTER (WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date) AS this_week_count
  FROM agg_event_daily
  WHERE (summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
         AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date)
     OR summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT event_name,
       COALESCE(last_week_count, 0) AS last_week_count,
       COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) AS this_week_count,
       COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_count, 0) AS change_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(this_week_count, 0) - COALESCE(last_week_count, 0)) / NULLIF(last_week_count, 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM weekly
ORDER BY event_name

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 nov_mega_sale 캠페인 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT '최근 7일'::text AS period, current_date - 7 AS start_date, current_date AS end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '그 전 7일', current_date - 14, current_date - 7
), totals AS (
  SELECT p.period, p.start_date, p.end_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.sessions), 0) AS sessions
  FROM periods p
  LEFT JOIN agg_traffic_hourly t
    ON t.summary_date >= p.start_date
   AND t.summary_date < p.end_date
   AND t.traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
  GROUP BY p.period, p.start_date, p.end_date
)
SELECT period, start_date, end_date, sessions,
       sessions - LAG(sessions) OVER (ORDER BY start_date) AS change_vs_previous,
       ROUND(100.0 * (sessions - LAG(sessions) OVER (ORDER BY start_date)) / NULLIF(LAG(sessions) OVER (ORDER BY start_date), 0), 1) AS change_pct
FROM totals
ORDER BY start_date

items.question: 최근 28일 주말(토·일)과 평일의 하루 평균 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, SUM(sessions)::bigint AS sessions
  FROM agg_user_session_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date) IN (6, 7) THEN '주말(토·일)' ELSE '평일' END AS day_type,
  COUNT(*) AS days_with_data,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
  ROUND(AVG(sessions)::numeric, 2) AS avg_daily_sessions
FROM daily
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM MIN(summary_date)) IN (6, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

items.question: 지난달과 이번 달의 일평균 페이지뷰를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT summary_date, SUM(page_views) AS page_views
  FROM agg_page_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date - INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND summary_date < current_date + 1
  GROUP BY summary_date
), monthly AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN summary_date < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date THEN '지난달' ELSE '이번 달' END AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS days_with_data,
    SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
    AVG(page_views::numeric) AS avg_daily_page_views
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT period, days_with_data, total_page_views, ROUND(avg_daily_page_views, 2) AS avg_daily_page_views
FROM monthly
ORDER BY CASE period WHEN '지난달' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

items.question: 지난주 세션 200개 이상인 유입 소스(traffic_source) 중 결제한 세션 비율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
WITH weekly_events AS (
  SELECT session_id, event_name, traffic_source, timestamp
  FROM events
  WHERE timestamp >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
    AND timestamp < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    AND session_id IS NOT NULL
), session_attrs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id)
         session_id, traffic_source
  FROM weekly_events
  ORDER BY session_id, timestamp
), session_payments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session_id
  FROM weekly_events
  WHERE event_name = 'is_payment'
), source_stats AS (
  SELECT a.traffic_source,
         count(*) AS sessions,
         count(p.session_id) AS paid_sessions,
         count(p.session_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS paid_session_rate_pct
  FROM session_attrs a
  LEFT JOIN session_payments p USING (session_id)
  GROUP BY a.traffic_source
)
SELECT traffic_source, sessions, paid_sessions, round(paid_session_rate_pct, 2) AS paid_session_rate_pct
FROM source_stats
WHERE sessions >= 200
ORDER BY paid_session_rate_pct DESC, sessions DESC
LIMIT 3
